race.title: Stables Business Park Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: Interesting stable-switcher ASIAN SPICE gets the call over last-time-out winner Savanna Storm . Raffles Nobu and Gone Country are others to consider in an open-looking race. ASIAN SPICE SAVANNA STORM (IRE) RAFFLES NOBU (FR)
